source.notes: arch-043 Mamba-1 + arch-044 Mamba-2/SSD (A8 read/write coupling). The selective SSM diagonal recurrence x_i = exp(δ_i·A)·x_{i-1} + δ_i·B_i·u_i, y_i = C_i·x_i with input-precomputable (selective) δ/B/C — a per-channel diagonal vector-state recurrence, structurally distinct from the K2 matrix state. Mamba-2 shares the same recurrence (A per-head broadcast, dt per head); its chunked semiseparable kernel (chunk_state/state_passing/chunk_scan) is a physical schedule. Verified against the pinned mamba_ssm selective_scan_ref (Mamba-1) and ssd_chunk_scan_combined_ref (Mamba-2). The δ/B/C/A discretization frontend, D·u skip, z gate and conv are external. Layer modules: architectures/mamba.py.
